claims.statement: The European Commission identifies installer shortages and reskilling as barriers to heat-pump deployment and estimates that 750,000 additional installers are needed while at least half of existing installers need reskilling.

Poland's UDT already operates formal F-gas certification paths for businesses and personnel installing or servicing relevant heat pumps, creating established credentialing channels but not a verified outcome record for each installation.

Hypothesis: reputable regional installers will pay for job-level proof that reduces handover disputes, differentiates their offer, and supplies fleet benchmarks; this willingness-to-pay has not yet been validated.

contrary_evidence: Existing manufacturer commissioning apps and statutory certificates may already satisfy many installers' perceived needs.
A 30-day observed-performance credential can be confounded by weather and occupant behavior and must not imply guaranteed seasonal efficiency.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: validate on 20 family-channel jobs, convert 10 regional installers through wholesalers/training partners, then make credential issuance a bundled handover step.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 60 installers in year 1; 350 by year 3 at roughly 1200 PLN monthly blended revenue; 1000 by year 5 at roughly 1500 PLN monthly. At 18M PLN ARR, 20% operating margin, a 3-5x ARR value, and at least 60% founder ownership, founder equity could exceed 5M PLN without requiring a sale; every milestone needs validation.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 12-16 hours/week through pilot and 18-22 hours/week only after paid repeatability, within the founder's 5-hours/day ceiling.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 78-86% software gross margin after telemetry, certificate signing, support, and occasional sensor amortization.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: under 4 months on 1500-3000 PLN blended acquisition cost when an installer issues at least five credentials monthly.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 699 PLN/month per installer plus 149 PLN per verified installation, with enterprise bundles for wholesalers.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: monthly retention follows recurring installations, warranty records, and access to installer/model benchmarks; target annual logo retention above 85% after product-market fit.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned dataset linking equipment, building context, commissioning choices, faults, and observed outcomes plus growing recognition of the credential
fingerprint.customer: Polish heat-pump installers with roughly 3-30 field technicians
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Initial family-company pilot, then heat-pump wholesalers, F-gas training centers, and manufacturers that can bundle the credential
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Commissioning workflow, weather-aware performance check, exception report, and verifiable customer certificate sold as credentialed workflow SaaS
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Installer pays a monthly platform fee and/or per issued job credential
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Commissioning, customer handover, first-season complaint, or warranty evidence request

founder_fit: Can pilot with the parents' renewable-energy company without depending on constant cold networking.
Uses data science, automation, and Polish-language workflow design.
Starts part-time with a software-first workflow and a small reusable sensor kit.
Creates a measurable outcome dataset rather than a labor-only consulting practice.
risks: Misleading performance claims or perceived substitution for regulated certification.
Manufacturer API fragmentation and installer resistance to exposing poor results.
Household energy data require explicit permissions and strong security.

structure.control_point: issuance and verification history of the job-level commissioning credential
structure.critical_dependency: installer adoption plus lawful access to comparable operating data

thesis: A commissioning workflow for small Polish heat-pump installers that turns a standardized handover and a short post-install monitoring window into a customer-facing performance credential. Each verified job improves model-, building-, and installation-pattern benchmarks, making the credential and troubleshooting guidance harder to replicate over time.
title: HeatPump Proof: Post-Install Performance Credential
uncertainties: The minimum sensor and data-access bundle needed for credible verification is unknown.
Installer, manufacturer, lender, and homeowner willingness to recognize an independent credential is untested.
The 45000 PLN capital estimate and all pricing, adoption, payback, and valuation figures below are planning hypotheses.
